Question: What is the general portal rule outside 3Shape?
Official Answer / SOP: For most digital portals, save/print the Rx/order first, verify the file is stored, then change the portal status to accepted/processed. Exact button labels differ by portal. The goal is to avoid losing the source document when the pending item moves out of view.
Keywords: portal, print before accept, save PDF, accepted, general rule

Question: What is the iTero scraping workflow?
Official Answer / SOP: In iTero, current/pending cases require action. The training workflow was to select cases (batching was supported), ensure the Rx is printed/saved, and download the scan files used by technicians. Because download/acceptance can move the case out of the current view, confirm the Rx is safely saved and use ABS/tracker checks before reprinting a case that appears previously handled.
Keywords: iTero, current cases, download scan, print, batch

Question: What is the Medit scraping workflow?
Official Answer / SOP: Select the pending case, save/print the order as PDF, verify the file, then return to Medit and change the order to accepted/processed. The Rx includes patient/case names, practice details, and work description.
Notes: Exact portal status wording was noted as not fully confirmed in training.

Question: What is the DS Core scraping workflow?
Official Answer / SOP: Open the pending order under All Orders, save/print the order as PDF, verify the file, then accept/process the order when the portal control is available.
Keywords: DS Core, all orders, pending, PDF, accept
Notes: The exact accept control was not visible during training; follow current portal UI.

Question: What is the Shiny scraping workflow?
Official Answer / SOP: In Shiny, red Pending cases require attention. Print/save the pending case and then change the status from Pending to Producing. Producing indicates the order has already been handled/downloaded.
Keywords: Shiny, pending, producing, red, save PDF

Question: What is the Shawman scraping workflow?
Official Answer / SOP: In Shawman, open the order, go to Files, download the Rx/file, save/print it as PDF, then return to the portal and accept/process the order. In Progress indicates an accepted order.
Keywords: Shawman, files, in progress, accept, PDF

Question: How should Ninjas coordinate portal scraping?
Official Answer / SOP: Only one Ninja should actively scrape the shared sequence at a time. Use the team's rotation/handoff process and announce the last completed patient plus the next patient to start so the next scraper continues from the correct point without overlap.
Keywords: scraping rotation, one scraper, handoff, next patient, overlap
Notes: Examples in production chat used explicit 'finished through X; continue with Y' handoffs.

Question: Why must scraping handoffs be explicit?
Official Answer / SOP: Multiple people can access portals simultaneously. Without a clear handoff, two Ninjas can download the same case or a case can be skipped. Always state the ending point and the next starting patient/order when transferring scraping responsibility.
Keywords: handoff, duplicate scraping, missed case, multiple users

Question: What ABS windows should be open before case entry?
Official Answer / SOP: Log in to ABS and open New Order, Case Photos, and Case Inquiry. New Order is used to create the case, Case Inquiry is used to verify existing cases, and Case Photos is used to attach the Rx/reference documents after the case number is generated.
Keywords: ABS, New Order, Case Photos, Case Inquiry, setup

Question: What duplicate check is required before creating a new ABS case?
Official Answer / SOP: Use Case Inquiry to search by patient name, doctor/practice, and available case details. Review prior cases before clicking New. If the same tooth/restoration appears to already exist, treat it as a possible duplicate/remake and escalate if the classification is unclear. A different tooth can be a valid new case.
Keywords: duplicate check, Case Inquiry, same tooth, different tooth, remake
Notes: Do not confuse this with duplicate-looking 3Shape scan files.

Question: What is the difference between a yellow duplicate pop-up and a yellow-highlighted office?
Official Answer / SOP: A yellow duplicate/history pop-up during case verification can indicate existing patient/doctor history and should trigger a duplicate check. Separately, a yellow-highlighted office/account may indicate the office owes money; Support confirmed that this billing highlight does not by itself stop Data Entry. Treat the two indicators according to their context.
Keywords: yellow pop up, yellow highlight, duplicate, owes money, ABS
Notes: This article reconciles two different yellow indicators documented in training/support.

Question: How do you start a confirmed new case in ABS?
Official Answer / SOP: After verifying that the case is eligible and not a confirmed duplicate, click New in New Order and begin entering the doctor, patient, Rx, due-date, shade, product, tooth/model, notes, and workflow information.
Keywords: ABS new case, New Order, create case

Question: What if ABS crashes before a case number is generated?
Official Answer / SOP: If ABS crashes before the case number is successfully generated/saved, the case entry must be restarted and reverified. Do not assume a case exists unless you can confirm it in Case Inquiry or see a generated case number.
Keywords: ABS crash, no case number, restart, save

Question: What is the first troubleshooting step for common ABS UI errors?
Official Answer / SOP: For common temporary ABS errors or missing UI options, restart/reopen ABS and retry. Production support specifically used restart guidance for missing Mini Model/options and general ABS errors. If the option is still unavailable or data is at risk, stop and escalate.
Keywords: ABS error, restart, missing option, Mini Model, troubleshooting
Notes: Do not repeatedly force a save if the case may become inconsistent.

Question: What doctor information should be verified?
Official Answer / SOP: Verify the doctor name, practice/office, address/ship-to information when relevant, and any doctor-identifying notes on the Rx or 3Shape. Avoid accidental doctor changes caused by scrolling in ABS.
Keywords: doctor, practice, office, address, ship to, scroll
